description:
A researcher is preparing a manuscript for the 'Journal of Applied AI' and needs to format references using their proprietary style. 

Your task:
1. Install the custom citation style file located at '/home/ga/Documents/journal-of-applied-ai.csl'.
   - Go to Edit > Settings (or Preferences) > Cite > Styles.
   - Click the '+' button to install a style from a file.

2. Create a bibliography for these three specific papers:
   - 'Deep Learning' (LeCun, Bengio, Hinton, 2015)
   - 'Attention Is All You Need' (Vaswani et al., 2017)
   - 'Generative Adversarial Nets' (Goodfellow et al., 2014)

3. Save the bibliography:
   - Select the 3 papers in your library.
   - Right-click and choose 'Create Bibliography from Items...'.
   - Select the 'Journal of Applied AI' style you just installed.
   - Choose 'RTF' as the output format.
   - Save the file EXACTLY to '/home/ga/Documents/bibliography.rtf'.
